source: City Art Studio; Blender pipeline 3d/plot/build_plot.py (helpers from 3d/v3 + 3d/lots, same camera and sun as 3d/parts)
scale: real scale: 1 m = 0.5 model units; storey 3.2 m = 12.54 px at 2x (6.27 game px). PR #57 placeholder prisms use 1.6 game px per metre (5.12 px per storey); these sprites use the true projection (1.96 game px per metre), about 22% taller than the placeholders.
anchorRule: anchor = ground point under the centre of the part footprint (sprite fractions; anchorPx in 2x px). PR #57 drawPlot: place(id, c.x, c.y) with c = P(footprint centre); depth as drawPlot (footprint far-front corner).
facing: <dir> = world edge the door/front faces after plot rotation (drawPlot face 1 NE, 2 SE, 3 SW, 4 NW). Designs are authored front on +i (SE) and every body door is on the design front, so key = part_<kind>_<f>f_<DN[face]>. NE/NW doors face away from the camera and are hidden (as in the placeholder).

selection.house: f 1-2 -> part_house_<f>f_<dir>; f 3-4 -> part_flats_<f>f_<dir>. Flats are WHOLE buildings: PR #57 has one body part with p.f floors drawn as one prism
selection.shop: part_shop_<f>f_<dir>, whole building (shopfront ground floor + office storeys). part_shop_office_floor_<dir> is an optional stack piece
selection.parking: part_parking_stall_<dir>, dir = plot face (stall front toward the plot front, like the placeholder car nose)
selection.sidewalk: part_sidewalk_<mask> from the 4-bit mask of neighbouring sidewalk or driveway cells (NE1 SE2 SW4 NW8, world terms after rotation). Only straight/corner/tee exist: straight for 0/1-bit masks, a tee for 15
selection.fence: part_fence_picket_<mask> / part_fence_chainlink_<mask> / part_hedge_<mask> (straight 5,10; corners 3,6,12,9); gates part_*_gate_<5|10>. Runs along the cell centreline; the placeholder draws on two cell edges
selection.lawn: part_lawn tiled under the lot (instead of the flat 0x6fb257 fill)

night: every part has <id>_night@2x.png: additive light-only RGBA (as building/prop _night art and design doc section 6). Windows about 70% lit; shopfronts, signs, door and bay lamps always lit. Ground parts, plants, fences: empty overlays (nightLitPx 0). For occlusion, bake unlit parts as black (doc section 6).

parts.stackRule: optional: draw at the body anchor raised by 12.54 px (2x) per storey above the shop ground floor; its own roof slab is hidden by the next storey
